chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It was among the supplications of the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family): 'I seek refuge in You from a woman who ages me before my (natural) time of old age.'

key_terms.أَعُوذُ بِكَ: I seek refuge in You — the classical Islamic formula for seeking divine protection
key_terms.تُشَيِّبُنِي: She ages/grays me — causes premature whitening of hair through distress
key_terms.مَشِيبِي: My (natural) old age/graying — the expected natural time of aging

ai.seo_question: What supplication did the Prophet Muhammad make regarding a harmful wife?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates a specific supplication of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), in which the Prophet sought divine protection from a woman who would cause him distress or anxiety — symbolized by premature graying. This hadith is situated in a chapter addressing difficult marital situations and is understood in classical scholarship as a prayer against harmful domestic strife that prematurely exhausts and ages a person. The phrase 'before my time of gray hair' (قبل مشيبي) employs graying as a metaphor for premature aging through worry and stress.
word_analysis: my (natural) time of gray hair/old age
